final_decision.rationale: Two-step pipeline in physical order blur->JPEG. JPEG existence high confidence (block_boundary 0% FP); blur presence unambiguous (JPEG-only sim 23.9 dB vs 32.5 dB combined). Motion chosen over deterministic gaussian/lens (angle-independent PSNR plateaus ~25.6 dB) and glass (22.76 dB). Noise ruled out (peeled noise_prior sigma=1.48<2; §B extreme_pct/spatial_corr are structured-residual false positives). No global (variance_ratio=0.9645, mean_shift=-0.3). Overall UNCERTAIN due to irreducible motion-angle randomness (angle is not a pipeline parameter) and near-miss block_boundary on support pairs.

reinterpretation_points: JPEG severity misjudged: R0 picked jpeg:1 from a PSNR tie (23.81 vs 23.91) and treated a systematic 10-15% block_boundary mismatch on supports 1-4 as a near-miss, arguing q25 was the mildest available level. Re-bracketing shows the target is stronger than q25: jpeg:2 matches bb on 5/5 supports and jpeg:3 overshoots by 32% on pair1. The boundary signal, not the PSNR tie, determines severity 2.

Blur subtype boundary re-examined: pair0 PCA=2.553 and anisotropy=1.6587 sit at threshold, but motion is replicated on all 5 supports (PCA 2.341-3.380; identify_blur_type motion 5/5; anisotropy 1.53-2.14), and isotropic families cannot exceed ~25.6 dB even at their untested maximum severity (gaussian:5 25.58, lens:5 25.60, deterministic) versus same-session control 26.32. The blur is directional.

Glass false-positive re-examined: glass_score 0.48-1.04 far exceeds the calibrated glass(2-4) band 0.19-0.41 and scales with JPEG strength (pair1 highest at 1.041), i.e. it is blockiness-inflated; glass:3 only reached 22.76 dB.

Noise second-order stats: low-confidence GAUSSIAN_YCrCb appears on all 5 pairs, but spatial_corr 0.83-0.93 structured residuals and the peeled extreme_pct=50.07 are the SKILL-documented blur/JPEG artifacts. Any noise_* severity 1 would add sigma ~12.75 (0.05x255) versus measured 0.74-1.85, so noise is excluded by an order of magnitude.

Global variance_ratio: pair1/pair2 variance_ratio 0.81/0.83 could mimic contrast weakening, but contrast_spread_ratio 0.885-0.975 and NO_GLOBAL 5/5; variance loss is an expected byproduct of strong blur + q18 JPEG.

Motion severity boundary: gm_ratio spans 0.319-0.657 across pairs (severity estimates 2-5), showing gm_ratio is content/angle dependent; the angle-invariant spectral_slope matches sev4 on 4/5 supports (jpeg:2 fixed), and sev5 is worse on pair0 (0.183 vs 0.166). Severity 4 retained; sev5 kept as alternative.
